name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Middleware & Route Guards
description: Implement RBAC hierarchy (admin > editor > viewer) and createRouteGuard middleware.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement RBAC security guards: 1) In src/rbac.ts, define Role = 'admin' | 'editor' | 'viewer' with hierarchy admin > editor > viewer. 2) Implement hasPermission(userRole: Role, requiredRole: Role): boolean. 3) Implement createRouteGuard(requiredRole: Role) middleware: accepts user object { role?: Role }, returns { allowed: boolean, statusCode: number, error?: string }. If no user or no role, return statusCode 401. If insufficient role, return statusCode 403. If allowed, return statusCode 200. Ensure test/rbac.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: src/rbac.ts exports Role type and hasPermission function
constraints: Admin can access editor and viewer routes; editor can access viewer routes
